subject: Aligning the demo: availability ladder + 15m buffer windows
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@auroraai.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@pi-analytics.com>, Satoshi Ito <s.ito@zenbridge.jp>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning the demo: availability ladder + 15m buffer windows

Hi Karen / Rajiv / Satoshi —

Thanks again for coordinating — we want to lock a single executive-friendly demo that includes a short 20-minute exec walkthrough followed by a 40-minute technical deep-dive (separate invite if helpful). To reduce jetlag/personal-hours impact for your leaders across US/EU/APAC, I sketched an "availability ladder" (attached) — staggered start times that let each region join within normal working hours where possible, plus a mandatory 15-minute buffer window after the demo for quick follow-ups or exec exit.

Proposed candidate windows next week (local conversions included):
- Option A: 2028-05-18 07:00 PDT / 16:00 CEST / 23:00 JST (favored for US late morning / EU late afternoon; late for APAC)
- Option B: 2028-05-17 16:00 PDT / 01:00 CEST (+1 day) / 09:00 JST (APAC morning, EU very late)
- Option C: 2028-05-18 05:00 PDT / 14:00 CEST / 21:00 JST (early for US; still OK for EU/APAC)

I'm attaching an availability_matrix.xlsx with region columns and who-can-join ticks. Please mark preferences directly on that sheet or reply with preferred option(s). Note: EU had a DST adjustment earlier this spring — if there are specific calendar quirks for exec travel, let us know and we'll build fallback invites.

Attachments: demo_agenda_v2.pdf, availability_matrix.xlsx, calendar-buffer-template.ics

Next steps if we can agree a slot: I'll send a single canonical calendar invite with the buffer period as a separate calendar item (makes it clear for execs that their time is blocked but optional).

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@auroraai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@pi-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T17:48:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Aligning the demo: availability ladder + 15m buffer windows

Ben —

Thanks, matrix looks useful. Quick notes from our side:
- Our VP of Product (EU) is in-market May 15–17 and has limited availability those days. He can do the afternoon of May 18 CEST.
- The DST shift in late March bumped a few recurring invites; we lost an hour when converting some calendars. Recommend we explicitly include timezone labels in the invite body (CEST/CET) and use the attached buffer template.

Preference: Option A (May 18 16:00 CEST) or Option C if you need to move earlier for US participants.

Also looping in Satoshi for APAC constraints (@Satoshi) — if there are travel or local holidays we should account for, flag them.

Karen
Karen Liu
Head of ML Platform | Aurora AI

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-05-15T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning the demo: availability ladder + 15m buffer windows

Thanks Karen — tagging a couple of practical coordination items so we don't bounce times: 

1) Can everyone add a priority number to the attached availability_matrix.xlsx (1 = best, 2 = okay, 3 = possible)? That will let us compute a least-disruption slot.
2) We recommend the single-invite + optional buffer pattern Ben suggested (the buffer is RSVP optional). When drafting the invite we'll add a short line: "This 15-minute buffer is reserved for quick follow-ups; attendees may leave after the exec walkthrough."
3) If Karthi/karthik (partner ops) sees repeated late-hour impact for APAC, we can plan a separate technical deep-dive at an APAC-friendly hour — keep the exec session small.

I've updated the matrix with preliminary internal availability and attached it as "availability_matrix.xlsx" (v2).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Ben / Karen —

We can do Option A (May 18 07:00 PDT / 16:00 CEST). Please include Satoshi on the invite for the APAC infra questions. For the exec window, our CEO prefers a 30-minute condensed walkthrough; technical folks (ours + yours) can stay for the deeper 40-minute follow-up.

Attaching a stub calendar file we can accept: "calendar-buffer-template.ics"

-Rajiv

All —

Quick operational proposal from partner ops: given the mix of exec and technical attendees, let's lock Option A for the exec walkthrough (single canonical invite) and immediately schedule a follow-up technical breakout at an APAC-friendly time the next business day. That avoids asking any APAC execs to join late-night calls.

If we lock Option A now, I will: 
- Create the primary invite with explicit timezone strings and a 15-minute optional buffer item
- Create a separate technical invite (60 minutes) targeted for APAC engineers and copy of our engineer leads
- Publish both invites as: "Aurora — Exec walkthrough (May 18)" and "Aurora — Technical deep-dive (May 19 APAC)"

Proposed canonical time for Option A in full conversions: 2028-05-18 07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT / 16:00 CEST / 23:00 JST (buffer 16:45 CEST / 23:45 JST) — please confirm and I'll send invites.

Karthik
